title: Cone and constrained colorful Carathéodory Theorems
summary: Holmsen proved in 2016 a generalization of the classical colorful Caratheodory theorem in which a matroid imposes additional constraints on the desired colorful transversal. His approach also works in the more general setting of oriented matroids, rather than relying directly on convex hulls. In this paper, we extend these ideas in several directions. First, we study which colorful Caratheodory-type results remain valid when convex cones replace convex hulls, as well as analogous modifications in the oriented matroid setting.
